scenes.title: Paying off early

visual.footnote: Overpay up to 10% a year with no charge.

scenes.narration: You can pay off up to 10 percent of what you owe each year at no extra cost. If you repay more than that during your fixed rate, there's an early repayment charge. It starts at 5 percent in year 1 and falls to 1 percent in year 5. For example, repaying an extra ten thousand pounds in year 1 would cost £500.
